text:
maria: Quick heads-up — CipherHSM asked to start the BYO-KMS marketplace listing process. Need to lock the certification timeline, SAML/SCIM contract points, and HSM attestation artifacts. Who can own the vendor L4 packet?
jonathan: I can take security review. Need their FIPS/CC attestation PDFs + KMS API Swagger. Also ask for JWKS URL and signing cert rotation plan.
tina: Legal and comms need an embargo date for the co-announcement. Suggest we target a soft-launch week of June 9 — gives partner 3 weeks to finish certs.
sachin: Engineering note: we need HSM attestation + sample provisioning flow. CipherHSM said they support PKCS#11 and a gRPC agent. Requesting the attestation now. Sample curl we need from them: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.cipherhsm.example/provision 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" 
  -d '{"key_type":"RSA","purpose":"signing"}'
```
maria: Perfect. Also confirm SCIM: do they support bulk replace and change events? Product teams expect SCIM v2 with PATCH and 429 behaviour documented.
jonathan: Ask them to confirm SCIM endpoints + example error codes. Also SAML: need metadata XML and entityID, and IdP-initiated flow test plan.
tina: I'll draft a one-pager PR outline. Can someone add a short bullet list of integration risks for comms? (e.g., BYOK UX, rotation complexity, SAML SSO link behavior)
sachin: Risks: 1) Key rotation latency during bulk rotate. 2) SCIM rate limits causing slow user syncs. 3) Fallback plan if HSM link goes down (auto-fallback to software KMS or queued ops).
marketplace-bot: Checklist created: https://redwood.in/marketplace/checklist/CipherHSM-BYOK (please confirm items 1-4).
maria: Next steps: jonathan ping CipherHSM for attestation + JWKS, sachin request provisioning sample + agent logs, tina to set embargo and draft PR, i'll schedule a 15-min sync Thu 10am PT and update the checklist. @cipher-hsm-contacts (external) please share artifacts before Wed EOD. :thumbsup:
